name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Lifecycle Marketing | Journey Automation, Segmentation & Retention
summary: Lifecycle marketer and automation architect with 5+ years building CRM and lifecycle systems inside 15+ years across SaaS, agency, and marketing operations. Built a 20+ workflow lifecycle engine at Solenzo covering capture, qualification, booking, no-show recovery, onboarding nurture, long-term reactivation, and review generation, then owned the reporting that showed which stages were actually converting. Hands-on in HubSpot, Salesforce, and GoHighLevel, with segmentation and data-hygiene discipline behind every build. Denver metro based.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Architected a complete lifecycle automation system of 20+ workflows spanning lead capture, tagging and routing, qualification, appointment booking with confirmations and reminders, no-show recovery, post-sale onboarding nurture, long-term reactivation, and automated review generation.
Design and deploy lifecycle sequences, onboarding journeys, segmentation, and lead scoring that activate, nurture, and retain users at scale in GoHighLevel and HubSpot.
Built segmented outreach engines and an automated audit workflow that scored a company's digital footprint and enrolled 180+ contacts into personalized sequences.
Build dashboards tracking funnel progression, conversion, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, and report results with recommendations on a regular cadence.
Maintain contact segmentation, lifecycle stages, and strict data-hygiene protocols across concurrent client CRM instances.
Run tests and iterate on conversion rates rather than shipping once, tracing conversion gaps past the campaign into landing pages and on-site experience where that is where the problem sits.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Produced complex multi-touch email sequences and conversion-focused landing pages that improved lead generation and pipeline.
Built campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations from the results.
Led integrated strategy across paid media, inbound, and content, coordinating execution across internal departments.
Translated performance data into strategic recommendations for multi-stakeholder accounts in HubSpot.

Analyzed partner utilization and engagement data to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Advised partners on retention strategy, customer health metrics, and automated workflows.
